prior_year_events.impact_description: 2017 was impacted by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria contributing to the costliest year on record for natural catastrophes and adverse development on prior years' reserves.
Wildfires in California in 2017 led to significant catastrophe losses contributing to adverse development on prior years.
Earthquakes in Mexico in 2017 contributed to the large losses on 2017 and prior underwriting years.
2018 was impacted by Hurricanes Florence & Michael and wildfire events which were smaller than 2017 but still net retained and contributed to adverse development.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1200 opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 767.4m. During 2019 the syndicate experienced an overall adverse development on prior years, reflected as a GBP 36.3m deterioration (strengthening of reserves), driven principally by large catastrophe losses from 2017 and prior (notably US hurricanes, California wildfires and Mexico earthquakes), and by attritional adverse development on certain short-tail classes. The movement was concentrated on property-exposed lines and several Marine/Energy subclasses that the syndicate has since exited. The development reflects both large loss activity and reserve recalibration and material adjustments were made to loss picks and reserving prudence.
raw_causal_phrases: This year our results have been affected by a series of large losses on 2017 and prior underwriting years and increased attritional losses on those same years.
These losses were largely on lines of business we have exited or subclasses of businesses no longer written so obviating the need for further reassessment.
In 2019, there has been an overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m (2018: improvement of GBP 11.1m).

The very disappointing performance in 2017 was impacted by the worst year for catastrophes in the United States for over a decade with Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the wildfires in California and earthquakes in Mexico
We also experienced large loss activity on 2018 which has influenced the actions outlined above.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 3 'Claims outstanding' (explicit "At 1 January 2019 767.4"). Prior year development sourced from narrative phrase in Risk Management: 'In 2019, there has been an overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m (2018: improvement of GBP 11.1m).' The document does contain a gross claims development triangle but formatting in the extracted text is ragged; reinsurance to close activity (closing 2017 YOA into 2018) may distort triangle-derived movements. The prior-year movement figure quoted in narrative may be net in some contexts; therefore confidence in the prior year movement being the authoritative gross movement is moderate (0.5). Lob-level reserve movement amounts are not quantified in the report and are inferred from narrative.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the report (includes an 'X and prior' aggregated column which has been excluded). The extracted text formatting of the triangle was ambiguous; numeric extraction of intermediate development rows was not reliable from the OCRed text. RITC activity (reinsurance to close) related to the 2017 closed year may distort comparisons; see data_quality_notes.
